title: Screens example
description: A 10-second example of a film made from SCREENSHOTS instead of a screen recording: two stills of a made-up app under a moving camera, a drawn cursor, rings on what the voice names, files that appear and a prompt that types itself. Copy the folder into projects/<id>/ and swap the pictures.

lines.text: Open the assistant and drop in your two files.
Then say what you need, in plain words.
